thread:
Claire (Growth): Quick triage 15m. We're finalizing launch posts + webinar — need: final KW mapping tailored to landing funnel, sitemap tweaks, schema for webinar + how-to, internal links, and a redirect rollback plan if analytics dips. Can we split tasks? :clipboard:
Diego: I'll take sitemap tweaks and the rollback plan. I'll export a sitemap diff and mark priority endpoints for crawl budget.
Nina: I'll take KW mapping and headline variations. Focusing on purchase intent and implementation queries.
seo-bot: Crawl update: 7 orphaned pages found, 2 pages with duplicate title tags, 1 candidate landing missing Event schema. Report: https://internal.crawl/1718123456-report
Aria: For schema, I'm going to draft Event + FAQ JSON-LD. Also propose adding HowTo for the post-webinar checklist (download slides, try the quickstart). Will include registrationAction as potentialAction.
Sam-Content: Messaging for benchmark narrative: lead with a measurable example ("customers saw 2x throughput at 30% lower cost") and follow with a technical deep-dive hook. Will write a short paragraph for the webinar invite.
Claire (Growth): Great. Redirect policy: prefer 302 for the first 48h post-deploy to monitor traffic and conversion; if stable, convert to 301. Need anyone else to own preserving utm params?
Diego: I will add rewrite rules that preserve query strings and implement a quick flag to flip to 301 in the CDN config. Will prepare rollback steps if we see >10% drop in organic conversions.
Nina: KW shortlist (draft): "LLM inference latency", "predictable inference cost", "inference batching best practices", "dedicated inference GPU", "inference caching techniques". Mapping: landing H1 = "Predictable LLM inference latency"; H2s oriented to cost, latency, deployment.
Aria: For Event schema include startDate/endDate in ISO, performer array with speaker names and sameAs, and eventStatus as EventScheduled. FAQ will include 6 Q/As: recording, prerequisites, replay, duration, expected audience, slides.
Sam-Content: Webinar hook variant: "Live benchmark + demo: see how engineering teams cut p50 latency and inference spend without trading off accuracy." Short and concrete.
seo-bot: Follow-up crawl scheduled 12h after schema injection to validate.
Claire (Growth): Owners: Diego = sitemap + rollback rules; Aria = JSON-LD + FAQ; Nina = KW + headlines; Sam = benchmark paragraph + invite copy. I'll collate and push to the release checklist. Thanks folks. :rocket:
